# TASK-113 — Navigation and settings consolidation

- **Status:** In progress — implemented, verification incomplete
- **Area:** Product follow-up (requested 2026-09-28)

## Intent

Navigation and settings consolidation: group configuration in Settings, remove duplicate destinations, and make optional navigation/actions follow server-enforced feature flags; evaluate retirement of the technology radar while retaining the technology catalog and stack workflow.

## What it delivers

MCP and connectors moved from Publishing to Settings > Integrations with their existing feature/role gates. Import removed from the sidebar. Technology radar and ring board retired (catalog kept for the stack picker; old links go to Stack); Open Questions retired (links go to Specification, unknown answers surface in Readiness); search moved to a top-bar dialog (Ctrl+K), scoped to the current project.
